name: cloud-me-api
description: Cloud Me API: read-only, authenticated read path to the owner's private cloud-me-* repos. The service holds one READ-ONLY deploy key per repo server-side, keeps a shallow clone of each declared repo, and serves declared JSON datasets (and filtered config files) to fleet apps, so no app holds a GitHub credential (#1079). First consumer: the cloud-webapps c3-* sites (#1063).

native_build._cmd_doc: No npm dependencies: stdlib-only ESM on node:22. RUN is a syntax check of our own sources so a parse error fails the BUILD instead of crash-looping a deployed container.
native_build.cmd: node --check index.mjs && node --check authz.mjs && node --check contract.mjs && node --check router.mjs && node --check store.mjs && node --check autocomplete.mjs
native_build._apt_doc: git and openssh-client do the read-only deploy-key fetch; ca-certificates for the HTTPS Authelia JWKS/session calls. No curl: the healthcheck probes with node.

deploy._host_doc: oci-analytics, same VM as git-proxy-api: reached at cloud-me-api.mesh.diegonmarcos.com over wg0, and publicly only at c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/cloud-me-api behind the shared gate (#1104); the service itself always verifies the Authelia bearer or session. An oci-apps ship would recreate my-ai_claude-api and kill running agents.

resources._doc: Clones live on a size-capped tmpfs (compose.nix), never on the VM disk: oci disks have sat at 87-97%. mem_limit covers node plus that tmpfs.

runtime._doc: THE endpoint contract, declared once. The image-wrapper COPYs build.json to /app/build.json and code/contract.mjs reads this block, so GET /me/endpoints serves it verbatim.

endpoints.description: Liveness. The only pre-auth route. Returns {"status":"ok","service":"cloud-me-api"} and nothing about the repos.
This contract from build.json runtime, minus transport fields (ssh URLs, key env names, host key) and the filter regexes.
The declared repos and their sync state: {repos:[{name,branch,commit,synced_at,ok}]}. A projection: no URL, key or path of the server is included.

A declared dataset (runtime.datasets[name]) as JSON: the file at {repo,path} of the last sync, parsed and re-serialised. Unknown name -> 404 not_found; a dataset that has not synced yet -> 503 not_synced; a file that fails the secret filter -> 403 secret_filtered and the file is never sent.

One config file of a declared repo (query `path`). Only runtime.files.allowed_ext, at most runtime.files.max_bytes, never a path matching runtime.files.deny_path, never content matching runtime.files.deny_content (403 secret_filtered). Errors {error,code}: 400 bad_path, 403 repo_not_declared/path_denied/secret_filtered, 404 not_found, 413 too_large, 503 not_synced.

#1103 The owner's Autocomplete rows {v:1,ids,addresses,urls,secrets:[{label,value}]} from runtime.autocomplete {repo,path}; only the four pages, string label/value, at most 500 rows a page. The one personal file served past the secret filter, so it is authenticated (Authelia bearer or session), no-store, and never reachable through /me/config or /me/repos/:repo/file. No file yet -> 200 with empty pages; repo not synced -> 503 not_synced.

autocomplete._doc: #1103 the ONE personal file this service serves past the secret filter, at GET /me/autocomplete: a JSON object {ids,addresses,urls,secrets: [{label,value}]} in a declared private repo. Cloud Account pulls it (mesh first, then c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/cloud-me-api with the fleet bearer) and hands it to Cloud Keyboard's own store. Absent file = an empty document.

repos._doc: The allow-list is DATA, here. Each repo is read with its OWN read-only deploy key (GitHub allows a deploy key on one repo only), delivered as a base64 sops env_file value named by key_env. cloud-me_vault is deliberately NOT declared: it holds credentials and the test asserts it is never served.

datasets._doc: name -> {builtin} | {repo,path}. The c3-* front ends fetch /me/config/<site>. builtin = real fleet config generated from this repo's build.json files by src/gen-c3-datasets.mjs into src/code/data/ (shipped in the image, never hand-edited; the test fails when stale). No placeholder seed is read.

files._doc: The no-secrets-in-responses guard. deny_path and deny_content are regular expressions (case-insensitive); a hit refuses the whole file, nothing is partially redacted. Every string leaving the service also passes redactSecrets() against the deploy keys it holds.

cors._doc: Browser callers: the c3-* pages are static sites on another origin and send Authorization: Bearer, so the service answers the preflight and echoes ONLY a declared origin. No wildcard, and no credentials mode.

session._doc: Same two credentials as git-proxy-api: an Authelia bearer (JWKS verified in-service) or a live Authelia session cookie asked of Authelia's auth-request endpoint; the user must be listed.

authelia._doc: Same three values infra-sec_introspect-proxy validates on, so a token minted for any existing Authelia client works unchanged.

api.description: Authenticated read-only access to declared datasets and config files of the owner's private cloud-me-* repos. Deploy keys stay server-side; secret-looking files are never served.
